## Figma Implementation Checklist

- [ ] Full desktop frame screenshot captured.
- [ ] Mobile frame screenshot captured, or missing mobile design noted.
- [ ] Chrome/Figma visual comparison completed.
- [ ] Major sections implemented from section-level node IDs.
- [ ] Key assets exported individually instead of using a full-page screenshot.
- [ ] Figma output translated into existing project components and conventions.
- [ ] Visual comparison completed at `1440`, `1024`, `768`, and `390` widths.
- [ ] Figma MCP was not used, or usage count and purpose are documented.
- [ ] Prototype/Present interactions were checked, or missing Figma motion specs are documented.
- [ ] Any intentional Figma deviations are documented below.

## Project Checklist

- [ ] Route, metadata, and static params are correct.
- [ ] Navigation updated if the page needs an entry point.
- [ ] Sitemap updated if the page should be indexed.
- [ ] Images exist under `public/images` and render in preview.
- [ ] Text content remains real HTML text, not flattened into screenshots.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Vercel preview checked
- [ ] Interaction or animation recording checked when relevant

List any differences from Figma and why they are acceptable.
